G'oya

Yozilishni (student_id, course_id) juftligi ajratadi, u birlamchi kalit. Ikki tashqi kalit har xil ON DELETE oladi: talaba bilan yozilishlari ketadi, kursni esa o'chirtirmaydi. Ball va holat orasidagi "faqat va albatta" qoidasi ikki yo'nalishli, shuning uchun ikkita CHECK.

Yechim

CREATE TABLE enrollments (
  student_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES students (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  course_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES courses (id),
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'davom' CHECK (status IN ('davom', 'tugatdi', 'tashladi')),
  score INTEGER CHECK (score BETWEEN 0 AND 100),
  PRIMARY KEY (student_id, course_id),
  CHECK (status = 'tugatdi' OR score IS NULL),
  CHECK (status <> 'tugatdi' OR score IS NOT NULL)
)

score ning o'zida NOT NULL yo'q, chunki davom etayotgan talabada u NULL. Uning qachon majburiyligini jadval darajasidagi ikkinchi CHECK hal qiladi.

Namunada Aziz SQL kursiga ikkinchi marta yozila olmadi. Malikaning balsiz "tugatdi" yozuvi ham, Statistikadagi balli "davom" yozuvi ham rad etildi. Azizning SQL kursi UPDATE bilan 92 ball olib yopildi. Statistika kursini o'chirish rad etildi (Bekzod yozilgan), Bekzod o'chirildi va yozilishi u bilan ketdi.

Tuzoqlar

Bitta yo'nalishni yozib qo'yish eng ko'p uchraydi. CHECK (status = 'tugatdi' OR score IS NULL) ning o'zi balsiz "tugatdi" ni o'tkazadi:

Noto'g'riCREATE TABLE enrollments (
  student_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES students (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  course_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES courses (id),
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'davom' CHECK (status IN ('davom', 'tugatdi', 'tashladi')),
  score INTEGER CHECK (score BETWEEN 0 AND 100),
  PRIMARY KEY (student_id, course_id),
  CHECK (status = 'tugatdi' OR score IS NULL)
)

Bitta CASE bilan yozganda ham shu teshik qolishi mumkin. CASE WHEN status = 'tugatdi' THEN score BETWEEN 0 AND 100 ELSE score IS NULL END balsiz "tugatdi" da NULL BETWEEN 0 AND 100, ya'ni NULL qaytaradi, CHECK esa uni o'tkazadi. THEN ga score IS NOT NULL AND ... qo'shish kerak.

0 ball ham haqiqiy ball: BETWEEN 1 AND 100 imtihonni yiqitgan talabaning kursni tugatganini yozdirmaydi.

Dialektlar farqi

PostgreSQL'da PRIMARY KEY (student_id, course_id) ikkala ustunni o'zi NOT NULL qiladi. SQLite'da bunday emas: NOT NULL siz course_id NULL bo'lgan yozilish jadvalga tushadi, tashqi kalit ham NULL ni tekshirmaydi. Ikkala bazada bir xil ishlashi uchun NOT NULL ni o'zingiz yozing.
